Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

new paragraph the final note should include the app version the free storage on each tablet the number of books downloaded and any titles left out because of space mention whether the offline test worked for both sample titles and whether the account remained signed in do not report the audio books as downloaded unless they were actually selected for a later session the printed room guide still says that all books should download automatically but that instruction is outdated mara asked me to leave the printed guide alone and use the app settings for this visit keep the shelf order as it is now and leave the final count visible on the west room shelf screen", "output": "For the reading app setup, I am dictating notes for the West Stairwell book room and the two loan tablets that stay there most weeks. The room has weak mobile reception, and the building Wi-Fi is shut off overnight, so the app needs to open downloaded books without waiting for a connection. Please keep the library account signed in on both tablets, but do not enable automatic downloads, because one tablet is shared with the youth group and the other is used by volunteers who bring it to the archive desk. The room coordinator is Mara Ellis, and she wants the same shelf order on each device.

The app is version 4.8.2 on both tablets. One is a Pine Tab 10 with 64 gigabytes of storage, and the other is a Pine Tab 8 with 32 gigabytes. The smaller one has about 11 gigabytes free after the map collection was added last month. The larger one has about 29 gigabytes free. The app currently stores its downloaded files in the standard books folder, but the coordinator asked me to change the preference so local copies are favored when a title is available on the device. Please set the configuration key on the following line to true in the settings editor.
reader.prefer_local
That is the exact key name, and it should not be renamed or turned into a folder path.

For the initial download, use the staff account and select the West Room shelf only. It has 186 titles, including 23 large illustrated books and 7 audiobooks. The audiobooks are listed for reference, but do not download them yet because the tablets have limited space. The illustration files average 48 megabytes each, and one title called Winter Field Guide is 612 megabytes. The staff account can download the books without a purchase prompt, but a personal account may show one, so stop if the app asks for payment rather than assuming the title is free. The shelf also contains 14 records marked returned, but those are old catalog entries and should not be selected.

Section 1: Preparation checks.
1. Confirm that the West Room shelf is visible while the tablet is online.
2. Check that the account name reads West Room Staff.
3. Make sure the download location is the standard books folder.
4. Turn on the preference requested above.
5. Confirm that automatic downloads remain off.
6. Record the free storage shown on each tablet before starting.

Use the larger Pine Tab 10 first because it has more room, then compare its shelf list with the smaller tablet. Do not remove the map collection or any personal notes while making space. If the smaller device reports less than 8 gigabytes free, leave the large illustrated books off that device and tell Mara which titles were skipped.

Mara said, “Please let the books finish downloading before the after-school group arrives at three thirty, and do not reset either tablet just to make the list look tidy.” The group usually comes in on Tuesdays and Thursdays, but this setup is being done on a Monday. She has asked for a status note by two forty-five, even if the download is still running. Include the number of titles completed and the number remaining, and say whether the app stayed open during the transfer. If the app closes by itself, reopen it and check the shelf before continuing. Do not restart a transfer until the displayed count has been recorded.

If the West Room Wi-Fi drops during the download, pause the job and wait until the tablets can connect again. Do not switch to a personal hotspot because the room plan does not include mobile data. If a download has already completed, it should remain available offline after the connection is gone. Test one ordinary novel and one illustrated title in airplane mode, but leave airplane mode off afterward. The test is only to check that local copies open; it is not a request to change account access or remove any online options. If either test title shows a spinning indicator, note the title and the time rather than deleting and downloading it again.

The small tablet sometimes displays an old shelf count until the app is reopened. The last time this happened, Mara waited about two minutes, and the count refreshed without a sign-out. So first wait two minutes, then reopen the shelf. If the count still looks wrong, take a screenshot and leave the existing downloads in place. There is also a blue sync icon beside the account name that can look like an error, but it only means that the app is checking for newer catalog information. Do not describe that icon as a failed download unless an actual title has an error message. The archive desk has a paper list dated April 12, and it can be used to compare titles, but not to replace the current shelf.

I will be at the room from one fifteen until three, and Jonah Lee can check the smaller tablet after three if needed. He has permission to inspect the app but should not change the library account or the download preference. The charging cabinet has two labeled cables, and the Pine Tab 10 uses the longer cable because its outlet is behind the book cart. Keep both tablets plugged in during the large downloads, and return them to the locked drawer before the youth group arrives. If the cabinet is occupied, ask the coordinator where to leave them rather than using the archive desk drawer.

The final note should include the app version, the free storage on each tablet, the number of books downloaded, and any titles left out because of space. Mention whether the offline test worked for both sample titles and whether the account remained signed in. Do not report the audiobooks as downloaded unless they were actually selected for a later session. The printed room guide still says that all books should download automatically, but that instruction is outdated. Mara asked me to leave the printed guide alone and use the app settings for this visit. Keep the shelf order as it is now, and leave the final count visible on the West Room shelf screen."}]
